Our letters

Two friendly, round fonts. One for big titles and one for reading.

Fresh Printed!

Fredoka for titles, signs, and the Clicker Cafe name.

Order up! Your tiny mug is ready.

Nunito for everything people read: menus, sentences, and prices.

How we talk

We sound like a friendly barista: warm, a little silly, and easy to understand.

Say it like this

  • Short, happy sentences
  • Coffee-shop words: brewed, fresh, order up, sip, treat
  • Say what a button does: "Charge" or "Next customer"
  • Prices in popsicle sticks, like "3 sticks"

Skip these

  • Big grown-up business words
  • Last names, school name, teacher name, or photos of the girls
  • Anything that collects info from visitors
  • Too many colors on one page

Example

"Welcome to Clicker Cafe! Pick a tiny treat, hand over your sticks, and we'll print a smile for you."

For the SVP of Printing

Copy this into any web page or tool so every piece uses the same colors and fonts. The POS already matches these colors. Its fonts are Apple system fallbacks so it works offline.

Show the code 
:root{
  --espresso:#2E1D16; --board:#26322D; --foam:#F3E3C8; --chalk:#F7F1E3;
  --sun:#F2A93B; --mint:#8FD1B5; --berry:#C2456B;
  --hot:#E8845A; --ice:#7FB7D6; --bake:#E9C46A;
  --display:"Fredoka","Avenir Next Rounded",ui-rounded,system-ui,sans-serif;
  --body:"Nunito","Avenir Next",system-ui,sans-serif;
}
/* Web: Google Fonts "Fredoka" (500,600) and "Nunito" (400,700) */
/* Word/Excel/print: install both fonts, or fall back to Arial Rounded / Calibri */
